title: Lusha MCP
description: Connect your own Lusha account. Tool calls spend credits from that account at standard Lusha pricing.

lushaConnector.title: Lusha connector
lushaConnector.description: Your Lusha MCP connector. Create one under Settings > API & Integrations > MCP connectors with the URL https://mcp.lusha.com/mcp and sign in with your Lusha account.
